webui.note: The first screen: Brotli-11, window 24, of _framework/ less the lazy set, on a publish from a clean tree. Budget 2026-10-28 (ADR 0205); measured 2026-11-19 with the explorer's components and Varve.Sparql lazy (ADR 0205, amended 2026-11-19). Raising it is an amendment to ADR 0205.

webui-explorer.note: The explorer's lazy set, the assemblies the boot manifest marks lazyAssembly, which must be exactly these; measured 2026-11-19, the budget that plus 5%, rounded up to 10 kB (ADR 0205, amended 2026-11-19). Varve.Sparql.Results joins it when a page streams a query; raising the budget or changing the set is an amendment to ADR 0205.
